'''Chentu Chek''' was a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. A 23-year veteran of the Guild, Chek served as Armory Master, sometime during the tenure of [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] as the Guild's Head.<ref name="Code" />

During their time as Armory Master, Chentu had contributed to the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]. Titled "Tools of the Trade", Chek's contribution to the handbook covered weapons, tech, vehicles, and traps.<ref name="Code" />
